tools.name: estimator_import_catalog
tools.description: Start a catalog import from a file. This is a placeholder — MCP cannot do file uploads. Describe the import request in the message field and the system will guide the user through the upload flow.

tools.name: estimator_review_import
tools.description: Review a pending catalog import batch before committing. Shows parsed rows with suggested service codes, categories, and pricing. You can approve all, skip individual rows, or edit values before committing. Requires an importId from a previous import.

tools.name: estimator_commit_import
tools.description: Finalize a reviewed catalog import, writing all approved rows into the user's service catalog. Requires an importId that has been reviewed. This action cannot be undone — rows are added permanently.

tools.name: estimator_setup_price
tools.description: Add a new service to the user's price book (service catalog). Every service needs: a unique serviceCode (e.g., CABINET_INSTALL, PAINT_WALLS, ROOF_INSPECT), a display name, category (general construction: demolition, framing, plumbing, electrical, hvac, drywall, paint, flooring, cabinetry, countertops, tile, windows, doors, insulation, appliances, general_conditions; roofing: tear_off, decking, underlayment, field_install, ridge_hip, flashing, misc, and others), unit (sq_ft, linear_ft, each, sheet, roll, bundle, hour, lump), and material/labor costs. Items in the catalog are used when creating estimates.

tools.name: estimator_update_price
tools.description: Update an existing item in the service catalog. Use estimator_get_catalog first to find the itemId. You can change the name, service code, category, unit, material cost, labor cost, minimum charge, or notes.

tools.name: estimator_get_catalog
tools.description: List all items in the user's service catalog (price book). Returns service codes, names, categories, units, and material/labor costs. IMPORTANT: Always call this before creating estimates to get valid service codes. Optional filters must match enum strings. Categories include general construction (demolition, framing, drywall, paint, flooring, cabinetry, tile, electrical, plumbing, general_conditions, …) and roofing (tear_off, decking, underlayment, field_install, ridge_hip, flashing, misc, …). Materials include general construction (drywall, interior_paint, hardwood, ceramic_tile, stock_cabinet, quartz, …) and roofing (asphalt_architectural, asphalt_3tab, metal_standing_seam, tpo, …). When unsure, omit both filters to fetch the full catalog.

tools.name: estimator_get_config
tools.description: Get the user's estimator settings — company name, default markup/waste percentage, tax rate, currency, contact info, license number, and default notes/terms for estimates.

tools.name: estimator_update_config
tools.description: Update the user's estimator settings. You can set: companyName, defaultMarkup (waste %), taxRate, companyPhone, companyEmail, companyAddress, companyLogo (URL), licenseNumber (contractor CCB/license number), and defaultTerms (terms & conditions appended to estimates).

tools.name: estimator_import_template
tools.description: Import a pre-built pricing catalog template into the user's service catalog. Call without arguments to see available templates (returns id, name, description, item count). Call with a templateId to import all items. general-construction-2026 is the general-construction starter (demolition, framing, drywall, paint, flooring, cabinetry, and the other trades). dealers-supply-2025 is optional roofing material pricing. Existing rows are not deleted. A legacy Misc row with no material for the same service code is moved onto the template category and material; prices, names, and notes stay. Other existing rows are skipped.

tools.name: estimator_list_price_catalogs
tools.description: List durable builtin price catalogs shipped with the estimator (region, effective date, markup policy). These are the MCP's stored price lists — not AgentOS memory. Use before seeding or resolving remodel defaults.

tools.name: estimator_get_price_catalog
tools.description: Read all unit-price lines from a builtin price catalog (service codes, units, material/labor split, review/confidence metadata). Default Portland remodel catalog id: portland-remodel-will-2026-06.

tools.name: estimator_resolve_price
tools.description: Resolve unit pricing for one service code with provenance: user price book → builtin catalog → optional intake override (overrideMaterialCost/overrideLaborCost). Returns source, region, effective date, and markupIncluded flag.

tools.name: estimator_seed_price_catalog
tools.description: Copy a builtin price catalog into the user's price book. Missing codes are inserted. A legacy Misc row with no material for that code is reclassified; prices stay unless overwrite=true. Rows are never deleted. Use portland-remodel-will-2026-06 for the Portland general-construction working rates.

tools.name: estimator_create_replacement
tools.description: Create a full roof replacement estimate from dimensions. The system calculates line items automatically from the roof measurements using catalog prices. Requires: projectName, roofMaterial (asphalt, metal, tpo, etc.), ridgeLengthFt, eavesFt. Optional: footprintSqFt, roofAreaSqFt, pitch, layers, hipLengthFt, valleyLengthFt, rakeFt, wastePercent. PREREQUISITE: The user must have catalog items set up for the specified roofMaterial — call estimator_get_catalog first to verify.

tools.name: estimator_create_repair
tools.description: Create a repair/service estimate with specific line items. Each line item needs a serviceCode that exists in the user's catalog — ALWAYS call estimator_get_catalog first to get valid service codes. Do not guess or invent codes. Pass: projectName, lineItems array (each with serviceCode, quantity, optional materialType and notes). Optionally link to a client/company via clientId/companyId.

tools.name: estimator_get_estimate
tools.description: Get a specific estimate with all line items, totals (material, labor, grand total), status, client/company info, and metadata. Returns the complete estimate detail needed for viewing, editing, or reporting.

tools.name: estimator_list_estimates
tools.description: List the user's estimates with optional filters. Filter by: status (draft, sent, accepted, declined), type (replacement, repair_service), clientId, companyId, or date range (from/to as ISO strings like 2026-01-01). Returns summary info — use estimator_get_estimate for full details on a specific one.

tools.name: estimator_add_line_item
tools.description: Add a line item to an existing estimate. The serviceCode must exist in the user's catalog — call estimator_get_catalog to verify. Pass: estimateId, serviceCode, quantity. Optionally add notes. The estimate totals are automatically recalculated.

tools.name: estimator_remove_line_item
tools.description: Remove a line item from an estimate. Requires estimateId and lineItemId (get lineItemIds from estimator_get_estimate). The estimate totals are automatically recalculated.

tools.name: estimator_update_line_item
tools.description: Update a line item's quantity, materialCost, laborCost, or notes on an existing estimate. Requires estimateId and lineItemId. Totals are recalculated automatically after the update.

tools.name: estimator_adjust_to_target
tools.description: Adjust all line items on an estimate to hit a specific target total price. Useful when a customer has a budget and you need to scale pricing to fit. Strategies: 'uniform' (default — scales all items proportionally), 'labor_only' (only adjusts labor costs), 'material_only' (only adjusts material costs). Requires estimateId and targetTotal.

tools.name: estimator_update_estimate
tools.description: Update an estimate's project name, status (draft, sent, accepted, or declined), site address, client or company link, client-facing notes, or the contractor-only internal note. Use internalNotes for an internal note the customer must not see. Use notes for text that can be shown to the customer. internalNote is another name for internalNotes. Does not change line items. Pass estimateId and only the fields to change. A result with ok:false means the save did not stick.

tools.name: estimator_delete_estimate
tools.description: Soft-delete an estimate. The estimate data is preserved but hidden from list views. This cannot be easily undone.

tools.name: estimator_duplicate_estimate
tools.description: Create a copy of an existing estimate with all its line items, pricing, and configuration. Optionally give the copy a new projectName. Useful for creating similar estimates for different clients or properties.

tools.name: estimator_build_remodel_estimate
tools.description: Build a reviewable residential remodel estimate from normalized intake scopes, optional takeoff quantities, catalog prices, and overrides. Lump room scopes (kitchen, baths) auto-expand into a per-trade breakdown of line items (demolition, cabinetry, countertops, plumbing, electrical, appliances, flooring, tile, finishes) — each with its own scope-of-work description carried in notes — so client-facing output is itemized, not a single vague lump (set intake.expandScopeComponents=false for the legacy single-line behavior). Returns line items with provenance, alternates (both baths, upstairs expansion, roof, wall moving), a default+custom assumptions list, default+custom exclusions, contingency/markup/profit breakdown, and reviewMarkdown. Pass project-specific items via intake.assumptions and intake.exclusions. Does not persist — use estimator_generate_estimate_from_takeoff or estimator_create_repair after review. Room scope keys: kitchen, bath_full, bath_half, bath_primary, bath_secondary. Trade/quantity scope keys: cabinets, drywall, paint, framing, roof, flooring, electrical_kitchen, electrical_bath. Whole-project phase scope keys: general_conditions, permits, demolition, protection, final_clean.

tools.name: estimator_build_remodel_deliverable
tools.description: Build a residential remodel deliverable package using the Matthew v3 golden output standard: contractor planning-budget tone, cover/header, executive summary option cards, scope basis, pricing summary, numbered detailed line items, key allowances, assumptions, exclusions, separated Option C alternates (never in headline totals), recommended next steps, and footer/validity language. Returns clientMarkdown + clientHtml + handoff JSON. Use preset matthew-portland-2026-06 for the reviewed Matthew Portland fixture ($339,025 full / $167,200 bank-budget; golden fixture at remodel-estimates/saved/2026-06-03-matthew-remodel-reviewed-v3/). Guards against superseded totals and generic AI prose. Does not persist — use clientHtml or handoff for PDF. For single-scope preview only, use estimator_build_remodel_estimate. Prefer estimator_draft_remodel_deliverable when you have scope notes and want the tool to assemble budget/full intakes.

tools.name: estimator_draft_remodel_deliverable
tools.description: Draft a sendable residential remodel deliverable from scope notes in a single call, following the Matthew v3 client-output section contract when scopeBasis/next steps are provided. Provide one fullScope.scopes list (each scope is a key like 'kitchen', 'bath_primary', 'drywall', or a custom slug, plus optional budgetLump/notes — the built-in catalog supplies label/unit/default rate). Budget package can be (a) explicit via budgetScope.scopes, (b) derived from full via budgetScope.derivedFromFull.omitFromFullKeys and/or replaceWithAllowanceLump, or (c) omitted to mirror full as collapsed allowances. Returns RemodelDeliverablePackage with clientMarkdown, clientHtml, handoff metadata, and reviewMarkdown (agent-facing, includes MCP guidance). Does not persist. Use for fresh remodel intakes instead of estimator_build_remodel_deliverable when you have not yet authored both intakes by hand.

tools.name: estimator_save_template
tools.description: Save an existing estimate as a reusable template. Templates capture the estimate's line items, quantities, and structure so you can quickly create similar estimates in the future. Requires the estimateId of the source estimate and a name for the template.

tools.name: estimator_list_templates
tools.description: List all saved estimate templates. Optionally filter by type: 'replacement' or 'repair_service'. Returns template names, types, and IDs. Use template IDs with estimator_create_from_template to create new estimates.

tools.name: estimator_delete_template
tools.description: Delete a saved estimate template permanently. This does not affect any estimates that were previously created from this template.

tools.name: estimator_create_from_template
tools.description: Create a new estimate from a saved template. The new estimate gets all the template's line items and structure. Requires: templateId (from estimator_list_templates), projectName. Optionally link to a clientId. The new estimate is created as a draft.

tools.name: estimator_list_versions
tools.description: List all saved version snapshots of an estimate. Versions are created automatically when significant changes are made. Shows version numbers and timestamps. Use this to track the history of changes to an estimate.

tools.name: estimator_get_version
tools.description: Get a specific historical version of an estimate. Returns the full estimate snapshot as it existed at that point in time — all line items, totals, and metadata. Useful for comparing current vs previous versions or reverting changes.

tools.name: estimator_upload_photo
tools.description: Attach a photo to an estimate by URL. The photo is downloaded and stored. Include a caption to describe what the photo shows (e.g., 'North-facing roof slope showing damaged shingles'). Photos can be included in PDF exports and analyzed with estimator_analyze_photos.

tools.name: estimator_list_photos
tools.description: List all photos attached to an estimate. Returns photo IDs, URLs, captions, and sort order. Use photo IDs when deleting photos or configuring PDF output.

tools.name: estimator_delete_photo
tools.description: Remove a photo from an estimate. Requires estimateId and photoId (get IDs from estimator_list_photos).

tools.name: estimator_get_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate statistics for the user's estimating business. Returns: total estimates count, estimates by status, total revenue (accepted estimates), average estimate value, estimates by type (replacement vs repair). Optionally filter by date range (from/to as ISO strings). Use this for dashboard data and business reporting.

tools.name: estimator_export_pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF document for an estimate. Returns a download URL (not the binary file). The PDF layout is controlled by the estimate's output config — use estimator_update_output_config to customize which columns, sections, and details appear. The PDF includes company branding from estimator config.

tools.name: estimator_update_output_config
tools.description: Configure what appears in an estimate's PDF output. Toggle visibility of: material costs, labor costs, unit prices, quantities, line item notes. Set custom header/footer text. Choose a template style. This controls the presentation layer — the underlying estimate data is not changed.

tools.name: estimator_email_pdf
tools.description: Email an estimate PDF to a primary recipient with optional CC recipients in one group email. Fetches and attaches the PDF server-side (no secrets exposed). Defaults to the account owner's email when recipient is omitted. Estimate client emails and linked client records are trusted without extra confirmation; any external To or CC address requires confirmExternalRecipient=true after explicit user confirmation. Respects the estimate approval gate before customer send. Returns send status and audit metadata.

tools.name: estimator_analyze_photos
tools.description: Analyze roof photos using Claude's vision AI. Provide image URLs (can be multiple). The AI identifies: roofing materials, visible damage (missing shingles, cracks, moss, ponding), approximate measurements, and repair recommendations. Use the optional prompt parameter to ask specific questions about the photos. Results can inform estimate creation.

tools.name: estimator_analyze_document
tools.description: Analyze a text document (inspection report, insurance scope of work, contractor notes) and extract structured estimating data — identified services, quantities, materials, and damage descriptions. Pass the document text in the text field. Use the optional prompt parameter to focus the analysis. Results can be used to create estimates with accurate line items.

tools.name: estimator_create_company
tools.description: Create a new company in the client book. Companies group clients (contacts) together. Include: name (required), phone, email, address, and notes. After creating, you can add clients to the company using estimator_create_client with the companyId.

tools.name: estimator_list_companies
tools.description: Search and list companies in the client book. Use the search param to find companies by name. Returns company details with a count of contacts and estimates. Always search here before creating a new company to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: estimator_get_company
tools.description: Get a specific company's full details including all its client contacts and a summary of linked estimates.

tools.name: estimator_update_company
tools.description: Update a company's details. Pass the companyId and any fields to change: name, phone, email, address, or notes.

tools.name: estimator_delete_company
tools.description: Soft-delete a company from the client book. The company's data is preserved but hidden. Clients belonging to this company are NOT deleted — they become unlinked.

tools.name: estimator_create_client
tools.description: Create a new client (individual person) in the client book. Clients can optionally belong to a company (pass companyId). Include contact details: name (required), title, phone, email, address, and notes. The client can then be linked to estimates via their clientId.

tools.name: estimator_list_clients
tools.description: Search and list clients in the client book. Use the search param to find clients by name, phone, or email. Filter by companyId to see all contacts at a specific company. Returns client details with linked company info. Always search here before creating a new client to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: estimator_get_client
tools.description: Get a specific client's full details including their company info and a summary of linked estimates (recent 10). Use this to see a client's estimate history before creating new ones.

tools.name: estimator_update_client
tools.description: Update a client's contact details. Pass the clientId and any fields to change: name, title, phone, email, address, notes, or companyId (to move them to a different company).

tools.name: estimator_delete_client
tools.description: Soft-delete a client from the client book. The client's data is preserved but hidden from searches. Existing estimates linked to this client are not affected.

tools.name: estimator_create_takeoff_project
tools.description: Create a takeoff project shell (commercial or residential). Upload inputs, run extract, review rows, commit, apply system pack, then generate estimate.

tools.name: estimator_get_takeoff_project
tools.description: Get takeoff project with inputs, rows, status, pack/profile, linked estimate.

tools.name: estimator_list_takeoff_projects
tools.description: List takeoff projects for the workspace.

tools.name: estimator_upload_takeoff_input
tools.description: Upload a takeoff input file (base64) for a project. kind: eagleview_pdf|eagleview_xml|eagleview_json|eagleview_csv|spec_pdf|spreadsheet|photo|voice|other. For remodel photo/drawing takeoff, use kind=photo or spec_pdf and pass optional remodelHints (cabinet LF, room dims, bath counts, flooring/drywall/paint/roof sf, risk flags) — quantities are reviewable, not auto-measured from pixels.

tools.name: estimator_run_takeoff_extract
tools.description: Run takeoff extractors on all uploaded inputs (idempotent).

tools.name: estimator_list_takeoff_rows
tools.description: List takeoff rows with evidence and review state.

tools.name: estimator_review_takeoff_row
tools.description: Approve, skip, or edit a single takeoff row.

tools.name: estimator_commit_takeoff
tools.description: Mark takeoff ready after all rows reviewed and area measurement approved (or override note).

tools.name: estimator_list_system_packs
tools.description: List built-in commercial and residential system packs.

tools.name: estimator_apply_system_pack
tools.description: Set system pack slug and optional service profile on takeoff project.

tools.name: estimator_list_service_profiles
tools.description: List service department profiles (includes v6 defaults).

tools.name: estimator_upsert_service_profile
tools.description: Create or update a service department profile.

tools.name: estimator_generate_estimate_from_takeoff
tools.description: Generate draft estimate from committed takeoff + system pack. Preflight fails if catalog codes missing.

tools.name: estimator_request_estimate_approval
tools.description: Request owner approval before customer send.

tools.name: estimator_approve_estimate
tools.description: Approve or reject estimate (workspace owner).

tools.name: estimator_get_estimate_approval
tools.description: Get latest approval status for an estimate.

tools.name: estimator_normalize_remodel_intake
tools.description: Validate and normalize a residential remodel intake payload for kitchen/bath estimating. Accepts project type, base scopes vs alternates, drawing/photo attachment metadata, exclusions/surprises, rate references, and optional remodelHints from takeoff. Returns provenance-backed scopes, Will Portland default rates, assumptions needing review, and an estimate-builder-ready payload.

tools.name: estimator_create_signing_request
tools.description: Create a contract signing request for an estimate. Returns a tokenized signing URL that can be shared with the client. The client can review and electronically sign the estimate at that URL. The signing request expires after expiresInDays (default 30). Does not send emails during implementation.

tools.name: estimator_get_signing_requests
tools.description: List all signing requests for an estimate. Returns status (pending/signed/expired/cancelled), signing URL, recipient, and audit metadata for each request.

tools.name: estimator_cancel_signing_request
tools.description: Cancel a pending signing request. Cannot cancel a request that has already been signed. The signing URL will become invalid immediately.
